referenceSource: Synthetic French speech generated with mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign-8bit during the operator's voice comparison. Not a human recording.
referenceText: Bonjour, prenez le temps de vous installer. Aujourd’hui, nous allons découvrir ensemble une histoire simple et agréable. Écoutez tranquillement, puis répétez à votre rythme.
selection: Operator preferred this conditioned Chatterbox voice to Qwen and Kokoro in the comparison.
processing: Speak each entry inside a French carrier phrase, compare the local Whisper transcript with the target text or its French phonemes, then extract the vocabulary item. New renders use DTW anchors and a quiet transition; each cached recording records its own alignment method.
validatorDependencies: whisper-cli with the local large-v3-turbo model and DTW token alignment, espeak-ng and ffmpeg.
pronunciationCaveat: Synthetic speech can mispronounce or add words; audio checks are not native-speaker certification.
